description: This file defines a singleton helper class for managing an SQLite database in a Flutter project. It includes methods for initializing the database, creating tables for notes and categories, as well as CRUD operations for these entities. The class encapsulates database access logic and provides a structured interface for interacting with the local database.

classes.name: DatabaseHelper
classes.description: A singleton class that manages database creation, connection, and CRUD operations for notes and categories tables in a local SQLite database.

methods.name: database
methods.description: Getter that asynchronously provides the singleton database instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: initializeDatabase
methods.description: Public method to initialize the database by ensuring it's opened and ready for use.

methods.name: _initDb
methods.description: Internal method to get the database path and open the SQLite database, setting up creation and upgrade callbacks.

methods.name: _onCreate
methods.description: Callback invoked on database creation to set up the necessary tables and insert default data.

methods.name: _onUpgrade
methods.description: Placeholder for handling database schema upgrades.

methods.name: insertCategory
methods.description: Inserts a new category record into the database.

methods.name: deleteCategory
methods.description: Deletes a category record by ID.

methods.name: getNotes
methods.description: Retrieves all notes ordered by last updated time.

methods.name: getNoteById
methods.description: Fetches a specific note by its unique ID.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID.
